data.name: Turbo Carnage
data.detailed_description:
Turbo Carnage throws you into a chaotic arena filled with relentless waves of evil clowns. The only way out is through speed, firepower, and teamwork.

Take control of post‑apocalyptic vehicles equipped with powerful weapons, from heavy machine guns to devastating plasma cannons, and turn the battlefield into a scrapyard of smoking clown corpses.

Level up to spin the loot wheel and swap for a better vehicle or weapon, instantly refilling your dwindling resources. Or stick with what you have and risk running dry.
Crush enemies with a high‑speed boost, call in explosive airstrikes, or blast them apart, but manage your ammo and fuel wisely. Once they are gone, you are as good as clown food.

Play solo for a personal challenge, or join friends in online co‑op, covering each other’s backs in an escalating, wave‑based fight for survival.

Key Features

  • Post‑Apocalyptic Vehicles – Choose from uniquely designed rides built for destruction.

  • Weapons – Railgun, Plasmagun, Lightning cannon ... All designed to shred clown hordes.

  • Boost & Crush – Use boost impact to obliterate enemies in your path.

  • Airstrike Support – Call in devastating bombardments to clear swarms.

  • Resource Management – Balance ammo, fuel, and airstrikes for long‑term survival.

  • Wave‑Based Arena – Survive against endless waves that grow stronger over time.

  • Loot Wheel System – Level up to earn spins for a new ride, a better weapon, or a crucial resource refill.

  • Co‑op Survival – Join forces online, revive fallen teammates, and fight as one.

Get ready to drive, shoot, and survive in the ultimate battle against the twisted clown horde.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
